description: Traces Song Jiang’s flight after killing Yan Poxi, Wu Song’s tiger encounter, his brother’s murder and failed legal redress, and the Happy Forest dispute that leads to betrayal and escalating vengeance. Examines reputation, domestic vulnerability, self-defense, the limits of private justice, and the later literary afterlife of these characters.
